text_blocks.snippet: Jardiance (empagliflozin) commonly causes increased urination, urinary tract infections (UTIs), and genital yeast infections.
snippet_highlighted_words: increased urination, urinary tract infections (UTIs), and genital yeast infections

list.snippet: Increased urination: Going more often or waking up at night because the kidneys remove extra sugar through urine.
Urinary tract infections (UTIs): Burning pain during urination or cloudy urine caused by bacteria growing in sugar-rich urine.
Genital yeast infections: Itching, redness, or thick discharge in women, or redness and irritation on the penis in men.
Dehydration: Dizziness, lightheadedness, or feeling faint when standing up due to fluid loss.
Diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA): A dangerous buildup of acid and ketones in the blood, causing nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, and trouble breathing, even with normal blood sugar.
Fournier's gangrene: A rare, life-threatening bacterial infection of the tissue between and around the genitals and anus.
Severe urinary or kidney infections: High fever, chills, or lower back pain.
Lower limb complications: Increased risk of foot or leg infections, sores, or amputations.
Serious allergic reactions: Rash, hives, or swelling of the face, lips, and throat.
